bodrumcastle.name: Bodrum Castle
bodrumcastle.slogan: Four towers, four nations, one harbour guarded since 1404.
bodrumcastle.line: Knights of St John began it around 1404, using stone taken from the Mausoleum of Halicarnassus.

halicarnassusmausoleum.name: Mausoleum of Halicarnassus
halicarnassusmausoleum.slogan: The tomb that gave every grand grave its name.
halicarnassusmausoleum.line: One of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, this tomb of King Mausolus gave us the word mausoleum.

knidos.name: Knidos
knidos.slogan: Two harbours at the end of the world, and a famous goddess.
knidos.line: Knidos was home to Praxiteles' Aphrodite, and its channel was formed into two harbours by a causeway.

kayakoy.name: Kayaköy
kayakoy.slogan: A hillside of roofless houses that still seems to listen.
kayakoy.line: About 500 stone houses stand empty since the 1923 population exchange, and inspired the village in Birds Without Wings.

kaunos.name: Kaunos
kaunos.slogan: Tombs carved into a cliff above the reeds of Dalyan.
kaunos.line: Herodotus mentions Kaunos first, as resisting the Persian general Harpagus in 546 BC; its harbour has since silted up 8 km inland.
